items.description:
### Link to Job Posting

https://hhmi.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/Pres_Fellows/job/Headquarters/HHMI-AI-Fellow_R-4604

### Company Name

Howard Hughes Medical Institute (HHMI)

### Job Title

HHMI AI Fellow (sponsorship not specified)

### Location

Chevy Chase, MD

### What category does this job belong to?

Data Science, AI & Machine Learning

### Does this job offer sponsorship?

Other

### Is this job posting currently accepting applications?

Yes

### Advanced Degree Requirements

- [ ] This position requires a Master's degree or higher

### Email associated with your GitHub account (Optional)

_No response_

### Extra Notes (Optional)

Two-year, term-limited role with rolling start dates; eligible for HHMI benefits. The posting gives no graduation-year or minimum-years requirement. It asks applicants to have built real things with LLMs and shipped at least one applied AI project or prototype that someone else used. Fellows build internal applications, agent workflows, and automations, and advise the President and COO. Primary location is HHMI Headquarters in Chevy Chase, with time at Janelia Research Campus in Ashburn, VA. Base salary: $150,000–$200,000. Sponsorship details are not stated in the posting.
